scripts.build: cd client && npm install && npm run build && cd ../server && npm install && npx prisma generate
scripts.start: cd server && npx prisma migrate deploy && npx prisma db seed && node src/index.js
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.seed: cd server && npx prisma db seed
scripts.migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.migrate:deploy: cd server && npx prisma migrate deploy
